name: Current Account Deficit
description: The current account balance covers trade in goods and services, income and transfers such as remittances. In April-June 2026 the deficit was $4.2 billion, or 0.5% of GDP, against $3.4 billion (0.4%) a year earlier.
source: Reserve Bank of India, Balance of Payments
releaseSchedule: Released quarterly, about two to three months after quarter-end.

chart.title: The deficit widened slightly
chart.subtitle: Current account deficit, % of GDP, April-June quarter
